title: Businesses are Rethinking Data Centers: Water
key_claim: "Many data centers use no water 96% of the time"; "many don't use water at all"; when they do it's "often recycled non-drinking water"
advertiser: America Connects (state channel; video not seen in Google ads Jul–Oct 2026 window)
funding_disclosed: Partly: the ad shows only the state group's name; the industry funder appears only in ad libraries
paid_for_by: America Connects (Data Center Coalition's state-campaign nonprofit); Google lists the payer as GMMB, Inc.
audience_who: Google publishes no age or gender data for these ads
factcheck_note: Counts hours, not gallons: water use peaks on the hottest days (peak demand can run 6–10 times the average). No facility data is published, and the ads were later reworded to 'Some… for cooling'. Virginia Connects is a co-defendant in L-01, which challenges AWS's similar '97% of the year' claim.
